name: Jetour
verdict: Jetour is a brand of Chery Automobile, whose HKEX filings show Chinese provincial state entities holding large stakes without control - Wuhu SASAC alone reaches about 19% through Wuhu Investment Holding's 20.08%, and Anhui provincial entities hold about 14.4% more; China has a documented record of serious abuses in Xinjiang.
note: Front-of-shirt sponsor of Al-Shabab for 2026/27 per 433FC's Saudi Pro League 2026/27 shirt-sponsor list (2026-06-15, https://433fc.com/saudi-pro-league-2026-27-shirt-sponsors/), which notes its list reflects confirmed 2025/26 contracts carried into 2026/27. Club history: Al-Shabab announced Jetour (via its Saudi agent National Supplies Company) as a strategic sponsor on 2025-08-28 (club X post, https://x.com/AlShababSaudiFC/status/1961177864130134200) and the club site announced a main-sponsor contract with the agent running to the end of the 2025-26 season (alshabab-sc.sa/blogs/792, 2025-11-29); no 2026-27 renewal announcement was found. Jetour is also FIBA's Official Car Supplier (see deals/fiba-jetour). Rating note: proposed 'concern' - the sponsor is a Chery brand; Chery's prospectus and 2025 annual report show Wuhu SASAC (95.59% owner of Wuhu Investment Holding, Chery's single largest shareholder at 20.08%) and Anhui provincial state entities (Anhui Credit Guaranty 9.46%, wholly owned by the People's Government of Anhui Province) holding well over 5% combined without control (the prospectus states Chery is not a state-controlled enterprise), and China's record of serious abuses in Xinjiang is documented by the UN OHCHR assessment and Human Rights Watch. ON HOLD: a proposed 'concern' rating (state stake of 5%+ with a documented record, no control) awaits a maintainer's review. Both Chery ownership-claim sources are the company's own HKEX filings; no independent second publisher was found (see the claim's note).

why.text: Jetour is one of Chery Automobile's five major brands, and Chery's prospectus makes Wuhu Investment Holding - owned 95.59% by Wuhu SASAC - its single largest shareholder with 20.08% of the company, alongside Anhui Credit Guaranty, wholly owned by the People's Government of Anhui Province, holding 9.46%. The UN human rights office found in 2022 that serious human rights violations had been committed against Uyghurs and other mostly Muslim communities in Xinjiang, including large-scale arbitrary detention that may amount to crimes against humanity.
why.messageLine: Jetour: a brand of Chery Automobile, in which Chinese provincial state entities tied to Wuhu SASAC and the Anhui provincial government hold large stakes (Wuhu SASAC alone reaches about 19% through its 95.59%-owned Wuhu Investment Holding's 20.08%); the UN has documented serious abuses in Xinjiang.
